title: Keeps liquid cold and hot liquids hot.
text: Keeps liquid cold and hot liquids hot.. I love this growler!  It really does keep liquids cold for 76 hours. It keeps liquid hot, but not for 48 hours, but close.  Not enough to reduce the stars in feedback.  I love that it's not slick on the outside, it adds a little grip to it.  The pouring handle could be a bit bigger, but it is big enough to run a belt through if you want to carry it with you on a hike or bike ride.  The attached top, seals well and the top holder helps prevent dropping and losing.

product_metadata.title: Coleman Insulated Stainless Steel Growler
features: Durable, double walled, vacuum insulated 18/8 stainless steel design keeps beverages hot in the growler up to 41 hours and cold up to 76 hours
BPA free construction adds peace of mind
Textured grip is glove friendly, keeping hands warm and dry while you pour from the 64 ounce growler
Double hinge tpu lid tether is flexible, preventing wear and tear
Bolt on, high impact, full grip handle ensures you'll never lose the cap
